Compute Plücker coordinates for the three triangle edges relative to the ray direction using the helper function $\text{pluecker}(\mathbf{a}_0, \mathbf{a}_1, \mathbf{b}_0, \mathbf{b}_1) = (\mathbf{a}_1 - \mathbf{a}_0) \cdot (\mathbf{b}_1 \times \mathbf{b}_0) + (\mathbf{b}_1 - \mathbf{b}_0) \cdot (\mathbf{a}_1 \times \mathbf{a}_0)$ [S1, unofficial].

The claim describes the calculation of Plücker coordinates for triangle edges relative to the ray direction using a specific helper function. Source [S1] explicitly defines the helper function `pluecker(a0, a1, b0, b1) = dot(a1-a0, cross(b1,b0)) + dot(b1-b0, cross(a1,a0))` and shows the code `sx = pluecker(vec3f(0.f),dir,a,b)`, `sy = pluecker(vec3f(0.f),dir,b,c)`, `sz = pluecker(vec3f(0.f),dir,c,a)`. This matches the claim's description of computing Plücker coordinates for the three triangle edges relative to the ray direction using the specified formula.
